content.short: Pike Finance is a cross-chain lending market designed for native asset interoperability.
content.description: Pike Finance is a decentralized, cross-chain money market that enables users to supply and borrow native assets across multiple blockchain networks without the need for traditional bridges or wrapped tokens. Utilizing a hub-and-spoke architecture, Pike allows for seamless liquidity movement and high capital efficiency, ensuring that users can leverage their collateral on one chain to access liquidity on another in a secure and transparent manner. The protocol prioritizes native asset security and minimizes the risks associated with cross-chain fragmentation in DeFi.
